rationale: This is water damage to the policyholder's own home structure and contents caused by failure of the policyholder's own plumbing system, which is a classic property_damage claim.
claim_summary: Homeowner returned from work trip to find basement flooded with approximately two inches of water caused by a burst bathroom supply line that ran for approximately two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, water-soaked drywall (up to one foot high), and ruined stored boxes. Estimated damage likely exceeds $25,000 and requires prompt inspection.

case_facts.description: two inches of water across entire basement, hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot high, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is a classic property damage claim with no third-party involvement or theft.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee reported wind damage to the back porch overhang with four shingles blown off during last weekend's wind event. No interior water damage occurred. Estimated repair cost is $400.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind, no interior water damage
